title: EI Graphics domain skill registry
description: An index of the domain skills this plugin ships. It says which domain identifiers are valid and where each skill document lives, and nothing more. Get-EiDomainSkillCatalog.ps1 fills in the description and the when-to-use list by reading each SKILL.md.

id.description: The domain identifier the agent uses. It matches the skill folder name.

skillPath.description: Path to the skill document, relative to the plugin folder.
